items.title: Novo Nordisk Stock Drops on Wegovy Shortfall
items.summary: U.S.-traded shares of Novo Nordisk are down more than 6% due to a sales shortfall for its new Wegovy weight-loss pill and a disappointing study outcome for a next-generation weight-loss drug.  Overall, the company sees the potential for a full-year sales decline of up to 6%, better than its previous view that sales could drop up to 12%.  Novo also disclosed that its experimental drug CagriSema failed to show comparable blood-sugar reduction to Eli Lilly’s tirzepatide in a new study of people with Type 2 diabetes.
